instruction: Follow all the reggae artists on Spotify that have at least 21 followers.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) plus supervisor. The number of reggae artists with >= 21 followers is only known at runtime, so the problem uses two placeholder artist objects (reggae-artist-1, reggae-artist-2) marked as matching-artist; at execution one spotify.follow_artist call is issued per artist returned by search_artists (paginated, genre == reggae, follower_count >= 21). search_artists needs no token; its effect (matching-artists-found) models that artist ids become known, and follow-artist is restricted to matching artists so nothing outside the criteria is followed (evaluation forbids extra or removed followings). supervisor-show-profile supplies the login username (supervisor email). supervisor-complete-task takes the matched artists as non-API parameters so its precondition mirrors the per-artist goal conjunction; it is called with status=success and no answer. Criteria values (query, genre, min follower count) are static init facts so the planner must search with the correct arguments.
